experiments.repeat_requirement: at least 3 trials per task; exact count per task not reported

experiments.certainty: high for plotted dimensions; trial count unknown

experiments.purpose: sort tasks by difficulty and inspect zero/low success tasks during task annotation

paper_method.environment: tool-agent-user interaction; actor sees policy/tools; user simulator receives task instruction; reward checks final database state and required information in agent responses
paper_method.main_method: zero-shot function calling; FC chooses either a user response or a tool call; compared with text ReAct and Act-only
paper_method.user_simulator_note: Single simulator profile is described; the reported cost breakdown is not a user-model comparison.
paper_method.sampling: paper describes i.i.d. stochastic trials from user and agent language-model sampling; exact per-episode seeds and raw logs are not supplied
paper_method.pass_k_definition: For each task with n trials and c successes, task estimate is binom(c,k)/binom(n,k); pass^k is the average across tasks. pass@k is 1 minus average binom(n-c,k)/binom(n,k). pass^1 is mean reward.

later_author_release.interpretation: Later released author artifacts; not original paper-v1 trials

source_limitations.effect: running documented defaults does not reproduce the main-results protocol

source_limitations.finding: paper §3 names gpt-4-0613; paper-era run.py and user loader default to alias gpt-4
source_limitations.effect: default source config does not prove exact simulator snapshot used for paper results
source_limitations.certainty: high for discrepancy; historical run resolution unknown

source_limitations.finding: paper lists model names/providers but generally not dated immutable model snapshots; code offers multiple dated candidates and aliases without mapping each published table row to one exact ID
source_limitations.effect: current aliases cannot be assumed to reproduce historical model behavior

source_limitations.finding: paper does not publish per-episode seeds, exact n per task, or raw run manifests; code's default Python random seed controls ordering but does not fix hosted model sampling
source_limitations.effect: stochastic run records cannot be exactly replayed from public paper/source alone

source_limitations.finding: paper says 4 of 40 initial failures were instruction typo/ambiguity and then fixed; published artifacts do not preserve those four pre-fix task versions and complete labels
source_limitations.effect: exact reproduction of the original 115-trajectory failure classification is blocked

source_limitations.certainty: high as of 2025-06-06 provider shutoff reported by parent; current availability is not inferred for other providers

source_limitations.effect: the later tree cannot silently replace the paper-era tree or be treated as the v1 benchmark state
source_limitations.certainty: high from local manifests and git diff
